facts.value: If you are considering a career in teaching and have a strong interest in science, this may be the course for you. This four-year programme attracts students who have excellent communication skills, and are strongly motivated and passionate about science teaching.
The aim of the programme is to educate young teachers and help them develop the skills and aptitudes to confidently face the challenges of science teaching.
